append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1674). PREMISE HELD at f7f7d3075 (main): the Elements view of components/loom/loom-picker.tsx still read "Upload generated art here, or generate new Elements (coming soon)." PROG-D7's close names what it shipped (embeddings, the hybrid, auto-tag, describe on view, background removal) and keeps the Weave composer a non-goal, so no generation was built for the picker to open; generation lives in the Loom Studio at /admin/library (the Recraft and create studios), which most picker users cannot reach. The promise was backed by an aiCreate toggle in the loom-picker registry entry ("AI Create", editor role, off by default), resolved by lib/loom/picker-actions.ts into LoomPickerConfig.aiCreate and read by nothing. WHAT CHANGED. The line now says what the view is ("Elements are the images in this library that were made with AI."), and the dead flag comes out of the registry, the config type, both defaults and the resolver, so /admin/elements stops offering a toggle that does nothing. A stored aiCreate value is dropped by normalizeElementConfig like any unknown key, so no migration. docs/EMBEDDABLE-ELEMENTS.md records the removal. components/loom/loom-picker.test.tsx (new) renders the picker and asserts no coming soon and no generate control, the four views and the scope rail, the Elements grid asking for AI-made images only, a pick, the empty state, and the registry keeping its working toggles. The Airwaves tab help text in the registry still says coming soon; that toggle is off by default and is outside this row.
